question_text: A 30-year-old woman with a 1-year history of medically-managed Graves disease visits her endocrinologist to discuss her desire to become pregnant and whether pregnancy is safe with her medications. Her temperature is 98.4°F (36.9°C), blood pressure is 110/66 mmHg, pulse is 78/min, respirations are 12/min. The endocrinologist advises that the patient may pursue pregnancy, but first needs to be switched to a new medication for her Graves disease. Which of the following is a possible side effect in this new medication that is not a risk in her old medication?
